verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an incident-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no self-hosted, on-prem or source-available deployment option. Everything points to a vendor-hosted SaaS: the API is hosted at api.incident.io, keys come from the incident.io dashboard, and the MCP server is remote. The Terraform provider configures the hosted service and does not deploy the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
